title: RenderGraph INTERFACE target is not directly buildable
body: A fresh queued target build failed before compiling: cmake --build VIXEN/build/gpudevloss --parallel 4 --target RenderGraph VIXEN vixen_editor test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture reported gmake: No rule to make target 'RenderGraph'. Running the generated target listing showed RenderGraph is INTERFACE-only; the concrete libraries are RenderGraphCore and RenderGraphNodes. Publish supported build target names in Build-System.md or provide a buildable aggregate target so a focused lane build does not need manual target discovery.

title: VIXEN asset staging must create the stamp parent on fresh builds
body: The queued target build failed after asset staging at cmake -E touch: failed to update VIXEN/build/gpudevloss/application/main/vixen_stage_assets/6d4cee9937001931.stamp because the helper does not create the stamp parent. I recovered with mkdir -p VIXEN/build/gpudevloss/application/main/vixen_stage_assets and reran the queued build. vixen_stage_assets should create the stamp directory before touching its stamp.

title: Editor capture save/reopen must use a build-tree document
body: The editor capture fixture launched vixen_editor without argv[1], so it loaded VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.vxd; its scripted save appended .edited.vxd and mutated the tracked VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.edited.vxd. I fixed this lane by configure_file(COPYONLY)-staging the input under runtime-captures/editor and passing it as argv[1]. Provide a declarative test-document path or an environment override so capture fixtures do not hand-wire copied document paths.

title: Box queue should recover from low-disk admission stalls
body: The queued scratch stress rerun ctest --test-dir build/gpudevloss-scratch --output-on-failure -j16 --schedule-random -R "BodyInstanceRayMarchRenderTest|EditorToggleUndoCapture|HudRenderCapture" remained unadmitted for about four minutes while free disk was below the queue floor. Cancelling caused the job to start and then terminate at 11/22 (payload exit 141); after external cleanup raised free disk to 46 GB, the same queued command completed 22/22. Surface the disk-floor blocker and a clear bounded recovery path so a cancelled job does not start mid-signal and consume a partial GPU run.
